verdict.rationale: Datalab's docs acknowledge document size/page limits and provide a page_range parameter plus checkpoint save/resume to process oversized documents in segments (datalab-docs-30, datalab-docs-29), which mitigates silent truncation but requires manual workarounds rather than transparent handling of arbitrarily large files. There is no first-party or independent evidence of a thousand-page or multi-gigabyte document being processed end-to-end without hitting these limits, and no explicit statement about timeout behavior for very large jobs. Missing for 10: direct evidence of successful large-scale (1000+ page or multi-GB) document runs, explicit timeout/retry guarantees, and independent benchmarking confirming no silent truncation.
